component.name: ROPER
component.summary: Local desktop editor for focused lyric writing

description.p: ROPER is a local GTK 4 desktop editor for writing, organizing, and refining lyrics. It provides a focused two-pane workspace for developing finished lines alongside raw material.

The application is designed for offline use and keeps writing workflows local to the machine. It includes artist and track organization, artwork support, built-in search, and keyboard-friendly editing.
